vcu_g_0159_20001e7e.name: rx_500_byte_12
vcu_g_0159_20001e7e.description: Element 7 of the frame 0x500 payload copy: payload byte 0x12 zero-extended to 16 bits. The other seven elements are in rx_500_bytes. Stored only in this packet (meaning not resolved).

vcu_g_0159_20001ed6.name: rx_311_word_0f
vcu_g_0159_20001ed6.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x311 (payload bytes 0x0F..0x10). Stored only in this packet; meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001ee6.name: rx_421_word_11
vcu_g_0159_20001ee6.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x421 (payload bytes 0x11..0x12). Stored only in this packet; meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001f1c.name: rx_311_word_0d
vcu_g_0159_20001f1c.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x311 (payload bytes 0x0D..0x0E). Copied to snapshot word 0x2000336C by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20001f1e.name: rx_311_word_0b
vcu_g_0159_20001f1e.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x311 (payload bytes 0x0B..0x0C). Copied to snapshot word 0x2000336A by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20001f2c.name: rx_422_word_0d
vcu_g_0159_20001f2c.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x422 (payload bytes 0x0D..0x0E). Stored only in this packet; meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001f3e.name: rx_423_word_11
vcu_g_0159_20001f3e.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x423 (payload bytes 0x11..0x12). Stored only in this packet; meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001f42.name: rx_424_word_0d
vcu_g_0159_20001f42.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x424 (payload bytes 0x0D..0x0E). Stored only in this packet; meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001f47.name: link_activity_event
vcu_g_0159_20001f47.description: Activity event flag. vcu_ninebot_frame_dispatch and its frame handlers set it to 1 for frames addressed to this controller. vcu_link_activity_heartbeat_tick reads it on every call, clears it, and uses it to reload link_timeout_ticks and set the link flag at 0x20001F48 (owned by the app packet).

vcu_g_0159_20001f58.name: display_sweep_active
vcu_g_0159_20001f58.description: Enables the downward segment sweep in vcu_display_sweep_down_step while set (otherwise all icons are on). Set from Ninebot command handling (1 unless the command byte is 0x0A) and cleared by vcu_link_activity_heartbeat_tick when the link times out.

vcu_g_0159_20001f6d.name: startup_announce_done
vcu_g_0159_20001f6d.description: Set to 1 by vcu_startup_announce_burst after its fourth round, which ends the one-time announce burst for good. Cleared by vcu_app_state_machine_tick on a state change. vcu_state11_maintenance_tick copies it to the flag at 0x20001FA8.

vcu_g_0159_20001f7a.name: rx_211_packed
vcu_g_0159_20001f7a.description: 16-bit value packed from received frame 0x211 by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch: low byte = payload byte 0x0B rotated left by one bit, high byte = payload byte 0x0C. The bit meanings are not resolved (probably status flags of the motor controller).

vcu_g_0159_20001f7c.name: rx_212_word_0f
vcu_g_0159_20001f7c.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x212 (payload bytes 0x0F..0x10) in builds other than 14a. Copied to snapshot word 0x2000337A by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_14a_20001f7c.name: b14a_ninebot_words
vcu_g_14a_20001f7c.description: Build 14a only: two 16-bit words at 0x20001F7C and 0x20001F7E. In this build they are written by vcu_ninebot_rx_cmd_handle (no decompiled line names them; accessed through a base register), while the other builds write 0x20001F7C from frame 0x212. Meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_20001f88.name: rx_401_byte_0e
vcu_g_0159_20001f88.description: Byte from received frame 0x401 (payload byte 0x0E). The drive-command code only lets its ramp timer count while this value is below 70 (0x46), so it is probably a percentage.

vcu_g_0159_20001f9c.name: rx_311_clamped_pair
vcu_g_0159_20001f9c.description: Frame 0x311 payload bytes 0x0B and 0x0C, each clamped to its upper limit: low byte = min(byte 0x0B, rx_311_limit_b0b), high byte = min(byte 0x0C, rx_311_limit_b0c). Packed into word 1 of CAN 0x20C by can_get_tx_payload_for_id.

vcu_g_0159_20001f9e.name: rx_311_word_0d_lo
vcu_g_0159_20001f9e.description: Low byte is set from frame 0x311 payload byte 0x0D by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch; the high byte is kept from earlier writes (its writer is not in this packet). Its low byte goes to byte 3 of word 1 of CAN 0x20C.

vcu_g_0159_20001fce.name: ninebot_timeout_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001fce.description: Up-counting tick counter that times out ninebot_timeout_active: it counts while that flag is set and, once it exceeds 1999, the flag is cleared. Reset to 0 by most Ninebot command paths and by the state machine on a state change. Present in builds 152, 153 and 0159 only.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd0.name: ninebot_timeout_active
vcu_g_0159_20001fd0.description: Flag set by Ninebot command handling (vcu_ninebot_rx_cmd_handle sets 0 and 1) and cleared by vcu_app_state_machine_tick once ninebot_timeout_ticks exceeds 1999. While it is zero, the state machine may switch to state 5 on a link condition (probably a fault state).

vcu_g_0159_20001fdb.name: rx_311_limit_b0b
vcu_g_0159_20001fdb.description: Upper limit applied to frame 0x311 payload byte 0x0B (see rx_311_clamped_pair). vcu_drive_command_update sets it to 0x23 or 0x34 after the product-code test on the serial string (probably a model-dependent limit).

vcu_g_0159_20001fdc.name: rx_311_limit_b0c
vcu_g_0159_20001fdc.description: Upper limit applied to frame 0x311 payload byte 0x0C (see rx_311_clamped_pair). vcu_drive_command_update sets it to 0x20.

vcu_g_0159_20001ff0.name: announce_word_d0
vcu_g_0159_20001ff0.description: 16-bit word sent as the two-byte payload of the startup announce frame with command 0xD0 (vcu_startup_announce_burst, to peer 2). Set to 0x0600 by vcu_identity_config_reload at boot. Meaning not resolved.

vcu_g_0159_200022e0.name: proto_sessions
vcu_g_0159_200022e0.description: Five 36-byte transport-protocol session slots (J1939 TP style sender and receiver state machines). proto_sessions_init binds each to a 300-byte buffer in proto_session_bufs and publishes the table through the descriptor at 0x20002970 (can_tp_session_table). Slot 1 starts at 0x20002304 (inside this object).

vcu_g_0159_20002394.name: proto_session_bufs
vcu_g_0159_20002394.description: Payload buffers of the five transport sessions, 300 bytes each: session i uses bytes 300*i..300*i+299 counting from 0x20002394. proto_sessions_init binds them. Buffer 1 starts at 0x200024C0 (inside this object).

vcu_g_0159_2000334c.name: rx_212_snap_0d
vcu_g_0159_2000334c.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x212 (payload bytes 0x0D..0x0E). Copied to snapshot word 0x20003378 by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_2000334e.name: rx_212_snap_11
vcu_g_0159_2000334e.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x212 (payload bytes 0x11..0x12). Copied to snapshot word 0x2000337C by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20003350.name: rx_401_word_10
vcu_g_0159_20003350.description: Low 16 bits of the 32-bit field at payload byte 0x10 of received frame 0x401. Copied to snapshot word 0x2000337E by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20003352.name: rx_401_word_0b
vcu_g_0159_20003352.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x401 (payload bytes 0x0B..0x0C). Copied to snapshot word 0x20003382 by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20003354.name: rx_401_word_0d
vcu_g_0159_20003354.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x401 (payload bytes 0x0D..0x0E). Copied to snapshot word 0x20003384 by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_2000335a.name: rx_341_word_0b
vcu_g_0159_2000335a.description: 16-bit value from received frame 0x341 (payload bytes 0x0B..0x0C). Copied to snapshot word 0x2000338C by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_2000335c.name: rx_425_byte_pair
vcu_g_0159_2000335c.description: 16-bit value built from received frame 0x425: low byte = payload byte 0x0D, high byte = payload byte 0x10. Copied to snapshot word 0x20003380 by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.
